finding: The activation-binding candidate validated a newly registered Layer before its initial reservations.json existed. The withdrawn full V3 observed two real branch-protection regressions with METADATA_INVALID. The same ordering affected first on for a native unregistered candidate.
fix: Inside the fresh-registration branch of on, publish the initial reservations document through the existing tracked writeJSON durability/recovery protocol before strict validateLayerIndex. The final save skips identical bytes. Ordinary reservations validation is unchanged; no missing-file exemption or alternate authority was introduced.
